annotation.title_clean: Komisia uverejňuje usmernenia k vymedzeniu systému umelej inteligencie s cieľom uľahčiť uplatňovanie pravidiel prvého aktu o umelej inteligencii
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the first AI Act's rules application
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published 6 February 2025 alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It links to the guidelines in all EU languages and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated based on practical experience
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules, covering AI system definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025
